title: Letters document.json, format 1
description: The document inside a .let file: a list of typed blocks holding runs of text. A reader keeps the fields and block types it does not know and writes them back. Block ids are unique across the whole tree, which this schema cannot express.

format.description: Rises only for a breaking change.

language.description: A BCP 47 tag such as en-GB. Defaults to en.

dictionary.description: Words every copy of this document accepts as spelled correctly.

properties.description: The document's own metadata, as the front matter of a Markdown file. The source is kept as written.

id.description: Stable, and unique within the document.

type.description: paragraph, heading, list_item, code, formula, quote, callout, divider, caption, figure, gallery, table, table_row or table_cell. A block of any other type is kept as written and drawn from its fallback text.

fallback.description: Plain text a reader shows for a type it does not know.

break.description: Starts the block on a new page.

checked.description: For a task item. Defaults to false.

then.description: The text is the code, its lines joined by a line feed with none after the last.
The text is the TeX source of a formula set on lines of its own.
A line in the caption style, as under a gallery.
A picture. The text is its caption, and it names its picture as an asset or as a src, never both.

asset.description: The entry of the file that holds the picture, such as assets/<sha256>.png.

src.description: The https address of a picture that is still remote.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for a reader who cannot see it. Defaults to empty.

width.description: The width it is shown at, in points.

height.description: The height it is shown at, in points.

numbered.description: Whether the caption opens with a generated number. Defaults to false.

then.description: Pictures shown together. Holds figures and captions: one caption, last, unless two people's changes left more.

numbered.description: Whether the caption opens with a generated number. Defaults to false.

then.description: Holds rows. A row may hold fewer or more cells than there are columns, as two people's changes can leave it: a missing cell reads as empty, and a column past the last one named aligns to the start.

columns.description: How each column aligns. Defaults to none named.

header.description: Whether the first row heads the columns. Defaults to false.

text.description: A block that holds text. A line feed in the text of a paragraph, heading or list item is a hard line break.

container.description: A block that holds other blocks.

run.description: A stretch of text with one set of marks. Offsets into a block count the UTF-8 bytes of its runs' text.

marks.description: bold, italic, underline, strike, highlight, code or math. Text marked math is TeX source set in the line. Any other mark is kept as written.

link.description: The address this text links to.

ref.description: The id of a block this text refers to, such as a figure. The text is what a reader that cannot follow it shows, and the block may be gone.

lang.description: A BCP 47 tag for text in another language than the document's. On a block it covers the block, and on a run it wins over the block's.
